checks.name: Completion writes all effects and immutable receipt once
Twelve independent retries return exactly the same receipt without duplicate effects
Concurrent different attempts preserve every aggregate update
Changed-answer race has one winner and a conflict without extra XP
A late response failure rolls back mastery, SRS, notebook, activity and scoring
Incomplete questions or wrong question identity cannot partially score
Foreign actor and extra answers are rejected
Legacy scored attempts return old result without any re-award
Snapshot replay survives source content deletion
Browser roles cannot finalize, forge progress, alter scores or read private snapshots
Owned reads remain isolated and shared simulator write grants are preserved
Wrong session owner prevents all progress changes
Failure saving the final receipt rolls back every completed side effect
